notes.title: New update released!
notes.notes:
We’ve just released a new patch for The Flame in the Flood!

Our main goals are to fix bugs, and alleviate some frustration and quality of life issues that people have given us feedback on. 

The main changes are as follows:
[list]
[*][b]Added Director’s Commentary:[/b] the previously PS4 exclusive director’s commentary is available for all. To enable it, you can toggle it on in the options screen.
[*][b]Fixed Save Loss:[/b] We identified an issue leading to save loss when attempting to continue. If you died during a process that advanced the clock (sitting at a fire, sleeping, docking) your save would enter an unreadable state, and checkpoints would no longer work in campaign.
[*][b]Achievement fixes:[/b] We fixed a number of issues with achievements failing to register, including Paleo Diet.
[*][b]Inventory: Added “discard all” option:[/b] For stacked items, you can now discard the whole stack at once.
[*][b]Inventory: Auto-sort items into existing stacks:[/b] When you pick up an item, it will auto-sort into any existing available stacks, or the first available inventory slot if no stacks are available. For example, if you’ve got a partial stack on Aesop, a new item will auto-sort to that stack, rather than into your backpack.
[*][b]Rabbit refactor:[/b] Rabbits now behave like other animals, in that you no longer need to skin them as a crafting recipe, and killing a live captured rabbit can be done from an inventory contextual menu.
[*][b]Fire crafting can be done in proximity to a fire:[/b] Fire recipes are now available near fires, not just while sitting at them.
[*][b]Added “Craft Multiple” button:[/b] Crafts the maximum possible of an item, so you don’t need to click over and over.
[*][b]More starting bag slots on traveler:[/b] New games on traveler difficulty have 2 pouches worth of bag slots already available.
[*][b]Crafting cost changes:[/b] Arrows only require 1 feather, sumac tea can be made with 1 sumac.
[*][b]Tools can be crafted with a full inventory:[/b] You no longer need to drop something to make a knife if your bags are full. Additionally, if you craft a tool that you already have, it will replace and refresh the durability of the existing tool.
[*][b]Inventory Stacking Changes:[/b] Stack sizes increased across the board, and many previously unstackable items can now be stacked, including jars, jar items, traps, and torches.
[*][b]Added UI element for equipped torch:[/b] it indicates the life remaining.
[*][b]Added quest caches at every camp:[/b] So now you can reliably find them.
[*][b]Added “mute dog” option:[/b] Sorry Aesop, not everyone likes those barks!
[*][b]Marina spawning on endless:[/b] Marinas now spawn continuously on endless.
[/list]

If you check it out and have any issues, please let us know. You can email us at support@themolassesflood.com, message us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/molassesflood/]facebook[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/molassesflood]twitter[/url], or leave a comment in Steam discussions.

notes.notes:

Crafty
Chatty

We also addressed some that were firing inappropriately:

notes.title: Update - Introducing Daisy Belle!
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

Not everyone may be aware of this, but back when we were just getting started on this game, we ran a Kickstarter campaign. We succeeded, and along the way we had a backer contribute enough to have their dog added to the game for everyone to use.

With the 1.1 update, we've added Daisy Belle! She's a dalmation/pointer/who-knows-what mix. You can select her via Scout options when you start a new game.

Thanks for playing, and we hope you enjoy your new canine pal!

notes.title: New Content Update: 0.5.002
notes.notes:
We just posted our newest content update, bringing a host of new features and bug fixes. If you have any issues, please report them in our discussions.

Among the update, the major new features are:

[b]BEARS[/b]: Bears and bear dens have been added. They are pretty tough, so plan ahead before picking a fight.
[b]SNAKES[/b]: Keep your eyes and ears peeled, there are now deadly snakes lurking about. If you get bit, you best fix it fast because a snake bite will kill you.
[b]QUESTS & CACHES[/b]: You'll now encounter quests and river caches. Complete the tasks you find for additional helpful supplies.
[b]QUICK DEPLOY[/b]: Gain fast access to key items via d-pad or numbers 4-7. Equip bows, torches, smoke jars, and tainted meat without needing to go into your inventory.

Full change list follows:

(NEW FEATURE)	Bears
(NEW FEATURE)	Snakes
(NEW FEATURE)	Loot Animation: loot boxes, cars, water pumps & wells
(NEW FEATURE)	Quest Caches & quests
(NEW FEATURE)	Additional explore islands

(NEW FEATURE)	Status orbs in UI now pulse when in dire shape
(NEW FEATURE)	Fill Gas contextual menu item indicates current fill level
(NEW FEATURE)	Added temp UI to indicate clothing warmth (retuning of warmth values still pending)
(NEW FEATURE)	Quick deploy items from D-Pad: bow, smoke jar, tainted meat, and torch

notes.title: New Version Posted: v 0.3.008
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We've just posted our first major content update since going into Early Access.

Of note: previous save games will not carry over, so you will need to start a new run if you have a save.

We've fixed a ton of bugs and added a bunch of new features. Noteworthy new features include:

[b]Bow & Arrow[/b] - craftable bow & arrows, they can be used to hunt predators & rabbits
[b]Wasteland Biome[/b] - A new environment to explore
[b]Buildable Camp Fires[/b] - make fires anywhere (that's not in water)
[b]Workbenches[/b] - finally, the full crafting tree is available
[b]Major Tuning Work[/b] - as always, feedback is needed! Item frequency, biome progression, stack sizes, crafting recipes - everything has been touched a bit.

The full change list is as follows:

(NEW FEATURE) Warm weather can now heat the player up at the same rate that cold weather cools the player
(NEW FEATURE) Raft inventory can be focused on while away from the raft, but items remain unusable
(NEW FEATURE) Raft impacts no longer can cause broken bones, can cause the loss of a random item
(NEW FEATURE) New conversation UI
(NEW FEATURE) New Biome progression: added more challenging biomes to endless progression
(NEW FEATURE) Make rags option: clothing items can be deconstructed to rags once a stone knife is held
(NEW FEATURE) Improved UI: Inventory now scrolls to focused item
(NEW FEATURE) Fires no longer cause burns: blocking capsule added to lit fires
(NEW FEATURE) Engine upgrade to UE 4.9.2
(NEW FEATURE) Consume stack option: stacks of items can be consumed at once
(NEW FEATURE) Added Workbenches - located at Hardware Store & Gas Station Locations
(NEW FEATURE) Added Wasteland Biome
(NEW FEATURE) Added UI elements for Gas when motor upgrade is installed
(NEW FEATURE) Added UI alerts for raft upgrade state changes: water collector, stove, gas
(NEW FEATURE) Added tiny scratches affliction from brambles
(NEW FEATURE) Added some location specific loot boxes
(NEW FEATURE) Added particle FX when looting on the river
(NEW FEATURE) Added new hazards: brambles, poison ivy
(NEW FEATURE) Added many contextual tutorial hints
(NEW FEATURE) Added location specific information when docking
(NEW FEATURE) Added feather item: shoo crows to produce feathers
(NEW FEATURE) Added Craftable Fires
(NEW FEATURE) Added Bow & Arrow
(NEW FEATURE) Added blood spurts on arrow hit, spear trap hit
(NEW FEATURE) Added Biome Names with biome information
(TUNING) updated many crafting costs for various items
(TUNING) stack sizes for many items increased
(TUNING) item frequency increased for many item types (lumber, saplings)
(TUNING) Global temperature tuning pass
(TUNING) Changed raft damage calculation: Damage now based on speed and angle of impact
(BUG FIX) Added ability to leave pause menu with ESC key
(BUG FIX) Reduced efficacy of tainted meat: only attracts 1 wolf, only can be eaten once
(BUG FIX) Increased chance of encountering Magnolia NPC at gas station locations
(BUG FIX) Fixed mouse/keyboard input on loot containers
(BUG FIX) Fixed marina bug where UI would not update quickly enough when upgrades were applied
(BUG FIX) Fixed jar light on wake from sleep
(BUG FIX) Fixed issue with Temperature: air temp now affects the player’s body temp
(BUG FIX) Fixed issue with some blurry item icons
(BUG FIX) Fixed issue with blurry textures on road pieces
(BUG FIX) Fixed issue with bait becoming uncollectible if collection was attempted with a full inventory
(BUG FIX) Fixed issue where water collector would stop functioning after save restore
(BUG FIX) Endless Mode games no longer give the “high ground” campaign quest
(BUG FIX) Changed rain timer to reset on biome transitions
(BUG FIX) Added full controller support for the options screen

If you encounter any issues or bugs, please let us know in our discussions.

notes.title: Hotfix #3 v0.3.006: Mac Start-Up Woes Fixed
notes.notes:
Greetings everybody -- just uploaded a late-night hotfix to address a crash on startup we (and many of you) were seeing on the Mac. If you were playing on the Mac either in OSX or Win7 through bootcamp, this crash should now be gone.

This will be version v0.3.006. Though we're not sure that the bug was affecting PC/Win7 systems, we updated both platforms, just to keep everybody in sync.

There remain a few crashes we are looking into that might be unrelated. Please keep the feedback coming if you have any problems, crashy or otherwise.

Really sorry about the inconvenience, everybody.

notes.title: Hotfix #2 v0.3.005 - Bug fixes galore
notes.notes:
Hi everybody -- Hotfix #2 just went live. No huge new features in this one, just a whole ton of bug fixes, addressing everything from crashes, to late-game slow-downs to mysterious disappearing rain.

Here's the full list:
[list]
[*] Player can now empty jars
[*] “custom cursor” setting is now saved & restored
[*] Consuming a jar on Aesop no longer destroys the jar if your inventory is full
[*] Cancelling at a well or pump no longer deactivates it
[*] Inventory focus remains in place when something is moved or used
[*] Crafting defaults focus to the item list, not the filter list
[*] Inventory size for the backpack now has a ceiling. After it’s hit, pouches can no longer be applied.
[*] expanded raft capacity, both default & with expanded storage upgrade
[*] Fixed floating leftover islands bugs
[*] Can no longer collect items at a distance by pressing E (mouse/keyboard only)
[*] ESC now cancels trap placement (mouse/keyboard only)
[*] Altered rain frequency & duration - it never lasts longer than a full 8 hour rest cycle
[*] Increased probability of flint at camps
[*] Rain system alteration: shelter no longer resets rain.
[*] Fixed issue where rain would break after restoring a save game
[*] Fixed rain particle bugs
[*] Fixed crash on docking
[*] Fixed rare crash on savegame restore
[*] Fixed late-game UI slowdown 
[*] Fixed issue with mislabeled Sumac Tea in your crafting menu
[/list]

Huge thanks to everyone who has sent in feedback and bug reports -- the vast majority of these fixes come from reports by you all. So thanks, you all are the best, and please keep the feedback coming!

 - TMF

notes.title: Hot Fix Update v 0.3.002
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We just set a hot fix live that should help with the difficulty, particularly for first time players.

There are 3 main things we've done:

[b]Wolf Frequency:[/b] Wolves won't spawn initially, which should give you time to gather up some resources before you get swarmed.

[b]Affliction Bleed Rates:[/b] The rate at which a number of afflictions cause your stats to bleed out has been reduced.

[b]Biome Ramp Up:[/b] The initial biome rafting experience has been eased a bit, so you'll hit fewer rapids in the first couples miles of the river.

Let us know what you think in the forums. Thanks!
